prompts: Edit this desktop application icon. Keep the existing rounded-square muted dark red / burgundy background, its precise size, position, corner radius, red gradient, and the transparent outer canvas unchanged. Keep the Figma-inspired F symbol's exact silhouette, shape, proportions, front-facing orientation, size, and centered position unchanged. Change ONLY the symbol's material from flat opaque white to elegant premium translucent sculpted glass. The F should look like real thick clear glass with a very lightly frosted pale interior, rounded polished bevels, crisp luminous white edge reflections, subtle refraction of the red background through the body, delicate warm rose transmission, soft realistic depth and a restrained shadow just beneath the symbol. Include a broad soft studio reflection across its upper left face and precise narrow specular highlights along selected beveled edges. Preserve excellent F silhouette readability at small app icon sizes. Front view, refined minimal macOS app icon finish, not a 3D perspective scene. Do not add text, letters, badges, additional symbols, extra objects, sparkles, a different background, or any surrounding mockup. The dark red rounded tile remains opaque; transparency is ONLY outside that rounded tile. Output one square app icon image.

Clean up this app icon for production. Preserve the beautiful translucent glass F mark, all its glass reflections and refraction, the red rounded-square tile, colors, shape, material, front view, and composition exactly. ONLY fix the alpha transparency outside the rounded red square: remove every stray red pixel, speckle, halo, noise, rough edge and stray fragment in the transparent margin. The outside must be completely clean, empty and fully transparent. The rounded-square boundary must be a precise smooth antialiased edge with NO exterior glow, no red fringe, no exterior shadow and no particles. Keep the panel itself opaque. This is a precise alpha-edge cleanup, do not redesign or add any elements.

Prepare a full-bleed square source texture for exporting a desktop app icon. Preserve the glass F logo in this reference exactly, with the same shape, scale, centered placement, translucent material, pale rose refractions, studio reflections, polished highlights and subtle shadow. Preserve the muted slightly dark red background gradient. Extend that same red background across the ENTIRE SQUARE canvas all the way into all four corners. The background must be completely opaque, smooth and continuous, edge to edge. No rounded-square panel, no panel boundary, no frame, no separate container, no transparent margin, no black background. This is a full-bleed square image; the app export pipeline will apply the native rounded icon mask afterwards. Do not enlarge or move the F symbol. No text, no particles, no speckles, no extra objects.
